items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: Lieutenant Charles F. Bates, our commander, and he wanted me to remain in the company.

ctx.x: Alright. I left Leveson Parish and moved over to East Baton Rouge Parish. I went to a place they called the Banker Place. My oldest brother, my daddy died, and I was three years old. My oldest brother was taking care of it. And each one of them getting married, the dozen would take my mother. We lived at the Banker Place, say, three years. We moved from there to Charlie Christian Place, about a mile above where we were first living. We'd lain there until I was 11 years old. I moved from there to Baton Rouge at 11…
